summary: AsiaStrategy (Nasdaq: SORA) filed a Form 6-K disclosing a share purchase agreement dated August 15, 2026, to sell 100% of its subsidiary AsiaStrategy Topwin SG Pte. Ltd., whose sole asset is 114,638,700 shares (7.07%) of Astra Enterprise PCL (SET:ASTR), to related parties Sora Valiant Limited and Asia Empire Development Limited for an aggregate US$10 million, payable in two tranches. The buyers are affiliated with co-CEO Jason Kin Hoi Fang and director Wong Fung Yee Mary, making the transaction a related-party divestiture approved by the board as in shareholders' best interests, citing U.S. Investment Company Act and registration burdens. The sale removes the ASTR stake, easing regulatory compliance; watch for related-party governance scrutiny and completion timing.
